items.title: Henry "Pickle" Jackson Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: Chris Kelly, Sam Morgan and Kid Rene. Yeah. But those was my favorite.

ctx.x: Who was your favorite trumpet player that you liked in those days? Did you like Buddy Petit or Chris or Sam Morgan? Or who would be your favorite?

Yeah, my favorite trumpet player at the time was Buddy Petit and Papa Celestine. Celestine. Yeah, Papa Celestine and Buddy Petit. And of course, all of them was good trumpet players. Chris Kelly, Sam Morgan and Kid Rene. Yeah. But those was my favorite.
Yeah, I heard Kid Rene and Celestine. I never did hear Buddy Petit before my time. Buddy Petit. He was a wonderful trumpet man.
